title: System overview and cross-lane result observations

sources.notes: Top-level startup outcome abstracted; exact shell/health semantics belong to admission/launch.
One invocation's routing, concurrent partial work and join; tensor payloads and detailed stream ordering abstracted.
Completion publication is distinct from provider success.

assumptions: Two remote lanes form a bounded concrete instance.
Startup and local/provider computation are atomic only at this HLD level.
No GPU numerical, memory-coherence or timing proof.
Temporal fairness property is typechecked, not model-checked by the default suite.

implementation_checks.description: Source inspection: errors counter increments on non-ok status and completion is still published unconditionally after the fence.
